name: lambda-transaction-update-cron

scripts.zip: npm run build && rm -rf .lambda-pack lambda-transaction-update-cron.zip && mkdir -p .lambda-pack && cp -r dist/. .lambda-pack/ && cp package.json package-lock.json .lambda-pack/ && npm ci --omit=dev --prefix .lambda-pack && cd .lambda-pack && zip -r ../lambda-transaction-update-cron.zip . -x '*.map'
